imagery_direction.hero_concept: Lake Erie shoreline at golden hour — peaceful water, wooden bench, autumn trees. Conveys peace and tranquility without being morbid. Grounds the site in Ashtabula's natural landscape.
imagery_direction.secondary_concept: Warm funeral home chapel interior — wooden pews, floral arrangements, tree of life emblem.
imagery_direction.photography_style: Warm, natural light. Local Ashtabula landmarks. Human-centered without being intrusive. Celebrating life and memory.
imagery_direction.pattern_style: Subtle warm gold/cream watercolor patterns at 12% opacity for visual richness without distraction.

voice_and_tone.description: Gentle and understanding, never pushy. Respectful of grief while being straightforward with information. Grounded in Ashtabula County with local references.

feature_highlights: Printable plan export (full binder + wallet card)

implementation_notes.hero_rendering: Gradient overlay (navy-to-cream) over hero image for text readability
implementation_notes.pattern_rendering: CSS background-image with inline style at 12% opacity
implementation_notes.form_styling: Warm cream inputs with navy focus border, 16px border-radius
implementation_notes.card_styling: White cards with large border-radius (32px), subtle shadow, gold-top accent border
